description: This file defines the Perl module 'Git::SVN::Fetcher', which is a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor. It implements callbacks to process Subversion tree deltas, capturing information about file and directory changes, properties, and placeholders to facilitate 'git svn fetch' operations within a Git repository. It manages interactions with external Git and SVN commands, tracks modifications, additions, removals, and absent paths, and handles special cases like empty directories and symlinks.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor that captures and records changes from Subversion to facilitate 'git svn fetch'. It tracks file/directory modifications, properties, placeholders, and absent paths, providing an interface for managing the state of the working tree during fetch operations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Fetcher object, loads configuration options, and prepares internal state such as ignore/include regexes, placeholder filenames, and interaction with Git and SVN.

methods.name: _mark_empty_symlinks
methods.description: Internal method to identify empty symlinks in the repository revision, used as a workaround for broken symlink handling.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within a '.git' directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be ignored based on ignore/include regexes and '.git' directory checks.

methods.name: set_path_strip
methods.description: Sets a prefix path to be stripped from all paths processed by this fetcher.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Initial handler for opening the root of the tree; returns a hash with the path.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Handler for opening a directory at a specific path.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a repository path to a Git-compatible path, handling encoding and path stripping.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles deletion of a path; removes associated entries, records deleted paths, and removes placeholders if necessary.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Handles opening a file at a given path, retrieving its mode and blob ID from SVN, and preparing it for delta application.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new file, setting its mode and preparing the data structures.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Handles addition of directories, including cleanup of existing directory contents and placeholders.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Records changes to directory properties.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Records directories that are absent or not conveyable.

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Records files that are absent or not conveyable.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Records changes to file properties, such as executable bits or special types.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Prepares to apply a text delta to a file, handling temporary storage and checksum verification.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes writing a file, verifying checksum, possibly handling symlinks, and inserting the object into Git.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Handles aborting an ongoing edit, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the edit, handling empty directories, placeholders, and cleanup.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Identifies directories that are now empty after deletions to possibly add placeholders.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Creates a placeholder file in an empty directory to preserve directory structure.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Stores the list of added placeholders into SVN config for persistence.
